name: Medetomidine
aliases: dexmedetomidine, Dexmedetomidine, (S)-medetomidine, Dexmedetomidin, Dexmedetomidina, Dexmédétomidine, Dexmedetomidinum, MPV 1440
summary: Medetomidine is a veterinary anesthetic medication with potent sedative effects. As of December 2025, it is an emerging illicit drug adulterant.
